title: SpaceX acquires Cursor maker Anysphere

sources.quote: The Exchange Ratio was calculated based on an implied equity value of Cursor of $60 billion and VWAP of the Company's Class A common stock over the seven consecutive trading days immediately preceding the closing of the Cursor Merger of $128.65.
Cursor Merger On June 16, 2026, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ("Cursor Merger Agreement") with Anysphere, Inc.

explain: SpaceX bought Anysphere, maker of the Cursor coding app, paying in SpaceX shares based on a $60 billion value for Cursor. The deal was signed June 16 and closed August 14, 2026; SpaceX booked total consideration of about $42.5 billion at the closing share price.
